package.name: human_trajectory_costmap_layer
package.description: A demonstration ROS 2 package that provides a dummy human trajectory prediction node and a custom Nav2 costmap layer. The dummy prediction node generates synthetic past and future pedestrian positions to simulate the input and output of the probabilistic trajectory prediction network described in “Reliable Probabilistic Human Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Applications”. The costmap layer subscribes to these dummy predictions and integrates them as gaussian cost obstacles into the Navigation 2 costmap.
